fixed_protocol.event_clock: log.transition_time selected exactly where stage1_position_event=1; each update is 100 Hz; non-event 1-ms interval is ZOH and is not fed to estimators.
fixed_protocol.action_input: same parent cosine-GRU raw stage1_position_event_applied_acceleration_mps2 as v1; only 24 TRAIN_C5_24 raw files bound by BATCH_BINDINGS.
fixed_protocol.gate_state_start: zero at first event >=2 s; output is zero before 2 s
fixed_protocol.action_mean_diagnostic: causal vector EMA tau=1 s, initialized zero; store mu[k], ||mu[k]||^2, and EMA_1s(||u[k]-mu[k]||^2); diagnostics do not enter either gate.
fixed_protocol.reference_gates: Reference acceleration is resampled to the same 100-Hz event times and evaluated separately through both fixed estimators; it never enters the action gate.
fixed_protocol.offline_grouping: W is parsed from scene_id only after computing action/reference features; it is not a filter or threshold input.
fixed_protocol.deployment_blend_contract: N4 state updates continuously; output contract remains clip(u_C5+g*(u_N4-u_C5), -3, 3) per axis.

per_event_arrays.shape_convention: scene x 1,999 events [x 3 axes for vector arrays]
